introduction:
Introduction About HCQS 200MG TABLET

HCQS 200MG TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine, a medicine from the Antimalarials and Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs) group, which supports managing malarial infection and helps regulate immune responses in conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults, and juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. It also assists in reducing skin reactions caused by sunlight exposure. Additionally, this tablet can complement diet and exercise to enhance blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin and sulfonylurea. HCQS 200mg is formulated to provide consistent support in immune-related and infectious conditions as part of a comprehensive health management plan.

HCQS 200mg Tablet is best taken with food or a glass of milk to help minimize stomach discomfort. Taking it consistently at the same time each day supports optimal absorption and effectiveness. It is important to continue the full course as instructed by your healthcare provider, even if you start feeling better, ensuring sustained support for your condition.

The most common side effects of HCQS 200mg Tablet include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, and loss of appetite. If any of these symptoms persist or worsen over time, it is important to consult your healthcare provider. Your doctor can offer guidance to help manage or minimize these effects and ensure your comfort while using the medication.

Before taking HCQS 200mg Tablet, inform your doctor if you have any heart, kidney, or liver problems, and provide a complete list of all medications you are currently taking. This medicine is not suitable for individuals with retinal or visual field abnormalities and is generally avoided for long-term use in children. Regular eye examinations may be advised to monitor vision while using HCQS. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should seek medical advice to ensure safe use of this medication.

mechanismOfAction:
How HCQS 200MG TABLET Works
How Does HCQS 200mg Tablet Work?

HCQS 200mg Tablet works by altering cellular processes within immune and parasite cells. It accumulates in acidic compartments like lysosomes, increasing their pH, which disrupts harmful parasite growth and modulates immune system activity to support balanced inflammatory responses.

Immune Modulating Action of HCQS 200mg:

The immune-modulating effects of HCQS 200mg include blocking toll-like receptors on immune cells, reducing overactivation of B and T cells, and lowering the release of inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-α and interleukins. This action helps regulate immune responses associated with autoimmune conditions.

HCQS 200mg and Cellular Function:

HCQS affects cellular function by interfering with antigen presentation and protein processing in immune cells, which limits the stimulation of autoimmune reactions. It also reduces neutrophil activation and platelet aggregation, contributing to decreased chronic inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use HCQS 200MG TABLET
How to Take HCQS 200mg Tablet

Take HCQS 200mg Tablet orally with a full glass of water, preferably after a meal or with milk to minimize stomach discomfort. Swallow the tablet whole without crushing or chewing. Consistent daily intake at a fixed time supports optimal results and helps maintain steady blood levels of the medicine.

Recommended Dosage Guidelines:

The typical adult dosage ranges from 200mg to 400mg per day, administered once or divided into two doses depending on clinical guidance. Children’s doses are calculated based on body weight and should adhere strictly to a doctor’s instructions. Dosage adjustments may be necessary based on response and tolerance.

Dosage Guidelines for HCQS 200mg:

Initial doses for conditions like rheumatoid arthritis or lupus often start at 400mg daily, which may be adjusted to 200mg or 400mg daily for maintenance. For malaria management, dosing schedules differ and must follow specific clinical protocols to ensure effectiveness. Always follow your healthcare provider’s dosing advice.

Administration Tips for HCQS 200mg Tablet:

Take the tablet with food to reduce gastrointestinal side effects. Avoid antacids within 4 hours before or after ingestion to ensure proper absorption. Regular eye examinations are recommended during long-term use to monitor for any visual changes.

Important Considerations for HCQS Dosage:

Do not stop taking HCQS abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if symptoms improve. Inform your healthcare provider about any heart, liver, or kidney conditions, as dosage adjustments may be necessary. Notify your doctor of all other medicines you are using to avoid potential drug interactions.

warnings.details: HCQS 200mg Tablet should be used cautiously during pregnancy only if recommended by your healthcare provider. Inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant or suspect pregnancy during management. Clinical studies indicate HCQS is generally safe in pregnancy at recommended doses, with no significant risk of major birth defects reported when used appropriately. Consult your doctor before taking HCQS 200MG TABLET.

This medication passes into breast milk in small amounts. HCQS 200mg Tablet should be used during breastfeeding only under medical advice to ensure safety for the nursing baby. Consult your doctor before continuing HCQS while breastfeeding.

Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery if you experience blurred vision or dizziness, or other vision-related issues while using HCQS 200mg Tablet. Ensuring safe response and alertness is important during management.

Patients with kidney impairments should use HCQS 200mg Tablet with caution. Inform your healthcare provider about any existing renal problems, as dosage adjustments and careful monitoring may be required. Consult your doctor before taking HCQS 200MG TABLET.

Patients with liver impairments should use HCQS 200mg Tablet with caution. Inform your healthcare provider about any existing hepatic problems, as dosage adjustments and careful monitoring may be required. Consult your doctor before taking HCQS 200MG TABLET.
Do not use HCQS 200mg Tablet if you have known allergies to Hydroxychloroquine or related drugs such as chloroquine or quinine, or any components of the tablet.

This medicine should be used carefully in patients with heart conditions, like cardiomyopathy, irregular heartbeats, or long QT syndrome. Discuss your heart health history with your doctor prior to using HCQS.

HCQS 200mg Tablet can be used in children only under strict medical supervision. The doctor will determine appropriate dosage, duration, and monitoring based on age, weight, and clinical condition. Consult your pediatrician before giving it.

Older adults aged 65 and above should use HCQS 200mg Tablet cautiously. Healthcare providers may recommend close monitoring and dosage adjustments based on overall health status. Consult your doctor before taking it.].

introduction:
Introduction About HYQ 400MG TABLET

HYQ 400MG TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. HYQ 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking HYQ 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. HYQ 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. HYQ 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking HYQ 400MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

HYQ 400MG TABLET works by increasing the potential of Hydrogen (pH) in a cell which disrupts the survival of infectious organisms and it also decreases the release of inflammatory enzymes. As a result, HYQ 400MG TABLET manages malarial infections in children and adults, it also manages rheumatoid arthritis and lupus erythematosus in adults.

Others

Have an eye problem which affects the retina (maculopathy)
Experience change in eye color or any other problem

Have abnormal blood sugar levels
Have glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency or porphyria
Have psoriasis
Have a blood disorder such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia
Have any problems with nervous system or brain
Have serious stomach or gut problems
Have a psychological disorder such as mood swings or suicidal behaviors
Had a bad reaction to quinine in the past

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking HYQ 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinedione such as pioglitazone, metformin (used to manage diabetes)
Digoxin, amiodarone (used to manage heart disease)
Azithromycin, clarithromycin, erythromycin, gentamicin, neomycin, tobramycin and  moxifloxacin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Neostigmine and pyridostigmine (used to manage myasthenia gravis and muscle weakness)
Tamoxifen (used to manage eye infections)
Halofantrine, mefloquine (used to manage malarial infection)
Amisulpride, quetiapine, risperidone (used to manage psychiatric disorders)
Rabies vaccine (used to manage rabies)
Ciclosporin (used to manage organ transplant rejection)
Praziquantel (used to manage worm infections)
Agalsidase (used to manage fabry’s disease)
Carbamazepine, sodium valproate, topiramate (used to manage fits or seizures)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes more of HYQ 400MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital immediately if the symptoms worsen. The symptoms may include abnormal or low blood pressure, low potassium levels in the blood, abnormal heartbeat, depression, seizures, impaired vision, transient blindness, cardiac arrest, coma or death.

faqs.question: Q: Can HYQ 400MG TABLET be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: HYQ 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice before taking HYQ 400MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are planning or doubt if you are pregnant.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of HYQ 400MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking HYQ 400MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is HYQ 400MG TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: HYQ 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. HYQ 400MG TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking HYQ 400MG TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking HYQ 400MG TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take HYQ 400MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of HYQ 400MG TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of OXCQ 300MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking OXCQ 300MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is OXCQ 300MG TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: OXCQ 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. OXCQ 300MG TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking OXCQ 300MG TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking OXCQ 300MG TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take OXCQ 300MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of OXCQ 300MG TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

introduction:
Introduction About HQTOR TABLET

HQTOR TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. HQTOR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking HQTOR TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. HQTOR TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. HQTOR TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking HQTOR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Can ZY Q 200MG TABLET be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: ZY Q 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ZY Q 200MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are planning or doubt if you are pregnant.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of ZY Q 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking ZY Q 200MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is ZY Q 200MG TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: ZY Q 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. ZY Q 200MG TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking ZY Q 200MG TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking ZY Q 200MG TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take ZY Q 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of ZY Q 200MG TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

introduction:
Introduction About QSLERA 200 TABLET

QSLERA 200 TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. QSLERA 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking QSLERA 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. QSLERA 200 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. QSLERA 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking QSLERA 200 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET

CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET Works

CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET works by increasing the potential of Hydrogen (pH) in a cell which disrupts the survival of infectious organisms and it also decreases the release of inflammatory enzymes. As a result, CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET manages malarial infections in children and adults, it also manages rheumatoid arthritis and lupus erythematosus in adults.

Always take CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease conditions.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinedione such as pioglitazone, metformin (used to manage diabetes)

Azithromycin, clarithromycin, erythromycin, gentamicin, neomycin, tobramycin and  moxifloxacin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Neostigmine and pyridostigmine (used to manage myasthenia gravis and muscle weakness)
Tamoxifen (used to manage eye infections)
Halofantrine, mefloquine (used to manage malarial infection)

Rabies vaccine (used to manage rabies)

Praziquantel (used to manage worm infections)
Agalsidase (used to manage fabry’s disease)
Carbamazepine, sodium valproate, topiramate (used to manage fits or seizures)

faqs.question: Q: Can CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice before taking CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are planning or doubt if you are pregnant.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of CARTIQUIN 200MG TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

faqs.answer: A: HYQ 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. HYQ 200MG TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking HYQ 200MG TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking HYQ 200MG TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take HYQ 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of HYQ 200MG TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CINKONA 300MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Dapsone (used to manage malaria)
Anticoagulants (used to stop blood from clotting)
Digoxin (used to manage heart problems)
Chloroquine, mefloquine, artemether with lumefantrine, primaquine, halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers or acid reflux and indigestion)
Amantadine (used to manage Parkinsons Disease or some viral infections)
Ciclosporin (used to manage transplant rejection)
Flecainide, quinidine, or amiodarone (used to manage irregular heartbeats)
Astemizole or terfenadine (used to manage allergic reactions)
Pimozide or thioridazine (used to manage some mental disorders)
Moxifloxacin, rifampicin, or antifungals (used to manage infections)
Medicines used to manage diabetes
Suxamethonium (used as a muscle relaxant)
HIV medicines (used to manage HIV infection)
Barbiturates, carbamazepine, or phenytoin (used to manage epilepsy)
Levacetylmethadol (used as pain killer)

B. Drug - Food interactions:

Avoid foods like fava beans during management with CINKONA 300MG TABLET if you suffer from severe glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, as this can cause episodes of anaemia.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CINKONA 300MG TABLET consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are trouble breathing, changes in heartbeat, fits, ringing in the ears or loss of hearing, headache, vomiting, changes in eyesight, muscle twitching or weakness, low blood sugar.

name: Lumerax DT 20mg Tablet 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET

LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET is a combination of Artemether and Lumefantrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used in infants, children and adults for the management of acute uncomplicated malaria (mosquito borne disease with symptoms of fever with chills, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain) caused by a parasite called plasmodium falciparum.  

LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney problems or if the patient feels worse or unwell to eat and drink.

LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs, kidney or brain, heart condition such as changes in the heart rhythm, slow heartbeat or severe heart disease and low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in the blood.

LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during the second and third trimester of pregnancy and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor.  

LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s age and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, vomiting, stomach pain, nausea, muscle pain and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET
Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET Works

LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET effectively manages malarial infections, where artemether effectively kills the malarial parasites by binding to haem (part of molecules that contains iron which is toxic to malarial parasites) which is produced during the breakdown of haemoglobin. Lumefantrine works by binding to hemin where it manages the formation of a toxic malarial pigment called hemozoin, thereby it manages malarial infection. In addition to this artemether and lumefantrine blocks nucleic acid and protein synthesis in parasite that damages the parasitic cell membrane of plasmodium falciparum which leads to the death of parasite. Thus, it helps in managing the malarial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET

Take LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET with a glass of water. This medicine should be taken with food or drinks rich in fat such as milk. Crush the medicine into powder if your child is unable to swallow the whole medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition.

LUMERAX DT 20MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION

FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION contains Artesunate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used for the management of severe malaria including cerebral malaria in adult and paediatric patients. Also, it can also be used against quinine resistance. 

Malaria is mosquito-borne acute febrile disease caused by a protozoan named Plasmodium falciparum. It is characterized by symptoms such as high fever, chills, sweating, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, body aches, weakness, agitation, confusion, fainting on standing up and anaemia (reduced red blood cell count). Cerebral malaria is the most severe neurological complication of Plasmodium falciparum malaria which may also cause coma.

FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have previous history of allergic reactions to artesunate or artemisinin derivatives. Before receiving FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you liver or kidney problems or any other problems.

FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION.  

FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION to your child. 

The most common side effects associated with the use of FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION are dizziness, light-headedness, headache, rash, hair loss, taste alteration (metallic/bitter taste), nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.
uses: Manage severe malaria including cerebral malaria
usesDetails:

Manage severe malaria including cerebral malaria
mechanismOfAction:
How FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION Works

FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION helps in managing malaria where Artesunate works by transforming into a metabolite and binds with iron component of blood and forms free radicals which inhibit the synthesis of protein and nucleic acid in Plasmodium parasites and manages it from invading red blood cells, thus managing the malaria effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION

FALCIGO 60MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse intravenously (into the vein) or intramuscularly (into the muscle). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ZY Q 300mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZY Q 300MG TABLET

ZY Q 300MG TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. ZY Q 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking ZY Q 300MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. ZY Q 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. ZY Q 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking ZY Q 300MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How ZY Q 300MG TABLET Works

ZY Q 300MG TABLET works by increasing the potential of Hydrogen (pH) in a cell which disrupts the survival of infectious organisms and it also decreases the release of inflammatory enzymes. As a result, ZY Q 300MG TABLET manages malarial infections in children and adults, it also manages rheumatoid arthritis and lupus erythematosus in adults.

Introduction About HQ STAR 400 TABLET

HQ STAR 400 TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. HQ STAR 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking HQ STAR 400 TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. HQ STAR 400 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. HQ STAR 400 TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking HQ STAR 400 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Have an eye problem which affects the retina (maculopathy)

Have any problems with nervous system or brain
Have serious stomach or gut problems

Had a bad reaction to quinine in the past

If you or anyone else accidentally takes more of HQ STAR 400 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital immediately if the symptoms worsen. The symptoms may include abnormal or low blood pressure, low potassium levels in the blood, abnormal heartbeat, depression, seizures, impaired vision, transient blindness, cardiac arrest, coma or death.

Introduction About CARTIQUIN 300MG TABLET

It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. CARTIQUIN 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking CARTIQUIN 300MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. CARTIQUIN 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. CARTIQUIN 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking CARTIQUIN 300MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of OXCQ 400MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking OXCQ 400MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is OXCQ 400MG TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?

introduction:
Introduction About FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION

FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION contains Artesunate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used for the management of severe malaria including cerebral malaria in adult and paediatric patients. Also, it can also be used against quinine resistance.   

Malaria is mosquito-borne acute febrile disease caused by a protozoan named Plasmodium falciparum. It is characterized by symptoms such as high fever, chills, sweating, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, body aches, weakness, agitation, confusion, fainting on standing up and anaemia (reduced red blood cell count). Cerebral malaria is the most severe neurological complication of Plasmodium falciparum malaria which may also cause coma.

FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have previous history of allergic reactions to artesunate or artemisinin derivatives. Before receiving FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you liver or kidney problems or any other problems.

FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION.  

FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION to your child. 

The most common side effects associated with the use of FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION are dizziness, light-headedness, headache, rash, hair loss, taste alteration (metallic/bitter taste), nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.
uses: Manage severe malaria including cerebral malaria

mechanismOfAction:
How FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION Works

FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION helps in managing malaria where Artesunate works by transforming into a metabolite and binds with iron component of blood and forms free radicals which inhibit the synthesis of protein and nucleic acid in Plasmodium parasites and manages it from invading red blood cells, thus managing the malaria effectively.
usageDetails:

FALCIGO 120MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse intravenously (into the vein) or intramuscularly (into the muscle). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About HYDROXYVAC 200 TABLET

HYDROXYVAC 200 TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. HYDROXYVAC 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking HYDROXYVAC 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. HYDROXYVAC 200 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. HYDROXYVAC 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking HYDROXYVAC 200 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LUMERAX 40MG TABLET

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET is a combination of Artemether and Lumefantrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used in infants, children and adults for the management of acute uncomplicated malaria (mosquito borne disease with symptoms of fever with chills, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain) caused by a parasite called plasmodium falciparum.  

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney problems or if the patient feels worse or unwell to eat and drink.

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs, kidney or brain, heart condition such as changes in the heart rhythm, slow heartbeat or severe heart disease and low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in the blood.

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during the second and third trimester of pregnancy and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor.  

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s age and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking LUMERAX 40MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, vomiting, stomach pain, nausea, muscle pain and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUMERAX 40MG TABLET
Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How LUMERAX 40MG TABLET Works

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET effectively manages malarial infections, where artemether effectively kills the malarial parasites by binding to haem (part of molecules that contains iron which is toxic to malarial parasites) which is produced during the breakdown of haemoglobin. Lumefantrine works by binding to hemin where it manages the formation of a toxic malarial pigment called hemozoin, thereby it manages malarial infection. In addition to this artemether and lumefantrine blocks nucleic acid and protein synthesis in parasite that damages the parasitic cell membrane of plasmodium falciparum which leads to the death of parasite. Thus, it helps in managing the malarial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use LUMERAX 40MG TABLET

Take LUMERAX 40MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow LUMERAX 40MG TABLET with a glass of water. This medicine should be taken with food or drinks rich in fat such as milk. Crush the medicine into powder if your child is unable to swallow the whole medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LUMERAX 40MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition.

Do not take LUMERAX 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Artemether, Lumefantrine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
LUMERAX 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having malaria with pulmonary edema or severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease or with heart diseases such as slow heartbeat, changes in the rhythm or rate of the heartbeat or family history of death due to heart problems or born with heart problems. LUMERAX 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with variations in ECG (prolongation of QTc interval). Consult doctor before taking LUMERAX 40MG TABLET.

Others

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Severe type of malarial infection that has affected the brain
Low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in blood

Before taking LUMERAX 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Infected with both the plasmodium falciparum and plasmodium vivax parasites
Feeling worse or if you feel too unwell to eat and drink

Use in pediatrics

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET should be given with caution in children as the dosages of LUMERAX 40MG TABLET vary in children according to their body weight. So, consult a paediatrician before you give this medicine to your child.

Use in geriatrics

LUMERAX 40MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

B. Drug – Food interactions

Drink grapefruit juice with caution while taking LUMERAX 40MG TABLET as it may interact with this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET

HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET Works

HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET works by increasing the potential of Hydrogen (pH) in a cell which disrupts the survival of infectious organisms and it also decreases the release of inflammatory enzymes. As a result, HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET manages malarial infections in children and adults, it also manages rheumatoid arthritis and lupus erythematosus in adults.

Always take HYDROWIN 400MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About HETQ 300 TABLET

HETQ 300 TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. HETQ 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking HETQ 300 TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. HETQ 300 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. HETQ 300 TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking HETQ 300 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How HETQ 300 TABLET Works

HETQ 300 TABLET works by increasing the potential of Hydrogen (pH) in a cell which disrupts the survival of infectious organisms and it also decreases the release of inflammatory enzymes. As a result, HETQ 300 TABLET manages malarial infections in children and adults, it also manages rheumatoid arthritis and lupus erythematosus in adults.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking HETQ 300 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Digoxin, amiodarone (used to manage heart disease)
Azithromycin, clarithromycin, erythromycin, gentamicin, neomycin, tobramycin and  moxifloxacin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Neostigmine and pyridostigmine (used to manage myasthenia gravis and muscle weakness)
Tamoxifen (used to manage eye infections)
Halofantrine, mefloquine (used to manage malarial infection)
Amisulpride, quetiapine, risperidone (used to manage psychiatric disorders)
Rabies vaccine (used to manage rabies)
Ciclosporin (used to manage organ transplant rejection)
Praziquantel (used to manage worm infections)
Agalsidase (used to manage fabry’s disease)
Carbamazepine, sodium valproate, topiramate (used to manage fits or seizures)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes more of HETQ 300 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital immediately if the symptoms worsen. The symptoms may include abnormal or low blood pressure, low potassium levels in the blood, abnormal heartbeat, depression, seizures, impaired vision, transient blindness, cardiac arrest, coma or death.

faqs.question: Q: Is HETQ 300 TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: HETQ 300 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. HETQ 300 TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking HETQ 300 TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking HETQ 300 TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNRIAM TABLET

SYNRIAM TABLET is a combination of Arterolane and Piperaquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarial agents. It is used to manage acute uncomplicated malaria infection due to Plasmodium falciparum in adults.

Malaria is a disease caused by a parasite which is spread to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes. Symptoms include fever, chills, headache, nausea, cough, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, muscle or joint pain, fatigue, rapid breathing, and heart rate.

Prior to management with SYNRIAM TABLET your doctor might want you to take some blood test to understand your existing condition.

Before taking SYNRIAM TABLET, tell your doctor if you have any liver, kidney disease. Consult your doctor for advice.

SYNRIAM TABLET should be used with caution in children. There is no proper information on the use of SYNRIAM TABLET during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and therefore consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking SYNRIAM TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, indigestion, cough, dizziness and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.
uses: Management of acute uncomplicated malaria infection due to Plasmodium falciparum
usesDetails:

Management of acute uncomplicated malaria infection due to Plasmodium falciparum
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNRIAM TABLET Works

SYNRIAM TABLET is a combination of two antiparasitic medicines. Arterolane and Piperaquine which manages malaria. They work by increasing the levels of heme in the blood, a substance toxic to the malarial parasite. This works against the parasite and stops the infection from spreading.
usageDetails:
How to use SYNRIAM TABLET

Take SYNRIAM TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VOHQ 200 TABLET

VOHQ 200 TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. VOHQ 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking VOHQ 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. VOHQ 200 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. VOHQ 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking VOHQ 200 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Can HIKEM TABLET be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: HIKEM TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice before taking HIKEM TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are planning or doubt if you are pregnant.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of HIKEM TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking HIKEM TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is HIKEM TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: HIKEM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. HIKEM TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking HIKEM TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking HIKEM TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take HIKEM TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of HIKEM TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

introduction:
Introduction About FALCINIL LFX TABLET

FALCINIL LFX TABLET is a combination of Artemether and Lumefantrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used in infants, children and adults for the management of acute uncomplicated malaria (mosquito borne disease with symptoms of fever with chills, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain) caused by a parasite called plasmodium falciparum.  

FALCINIL LFX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney problems or if the patient feels worse or unwell to eat and drink.

FALCINIL LFX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs, kidney or brain, heart condition such as changes in the heart rhythm, slow heartbeat or severe heart disease and low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in the blood.

FALCINIL LFX TABLET is generally not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during the second and third trimester of pregnancy and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor.  

FALCINIL LFX TABLET should be used with caution in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s age and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking FALCINIL LFX TABLET are headache, dizziness, vomiting, stomach pain, nausea, muscle pain and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of FALCINIL LFX TABLET
Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FALCINIL LFX TABLET Works

FALCINIL LFX TABLET effectively manages malarial infections, where artemether effectively kills the malarial parasites by binding to haem (part of molecules that contains iron which is toxic to malarial parasites) which is produced during the breakdown of haemoglobin. Lumefantrine works by binding to hemin where it manages the formation of a toxic malarial pigment called hemozoin, thereby it manages malarial infection. In addition to this artemether and lumefantrine blocks nucleic acid and protein synthesis in parasite that damages the parasitic cell membrane of plasmodium falciparum which leads to the death of parasite. Thus, it helps in managing the malarial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use FALCINIL LFX TABLET

Take FALCINIL LFX TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow FALCINIL LFX TABLET with a glass of water. This medicine should be taken with food or drinks rich in fat such as milk. Crush the medicine into powder if your child is unable to swallow the whole medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse FALCINIL LFX TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness or weakness after taking FALCINIL LFX TABLET.

FALCINIL LFX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the kidneys. It should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking FALCINIL LFX TABLET.
FALCINIL LFX TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking FALCINIL LFX TABLET.
Do not take FALCINIL LFX TABLET if you are allergic to Artemether, Lumefantrine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
FALCINIL LFX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having malaria with pulmonary edema or severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs. Consult your doctor before taking it.

FALCINIL LFX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease or with heart diseases such as slow heartbeat, changes in the rhythm or rate of the heartbeat or family history of death due to heart problems or born with heart problems. FALCINIL LFX TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with variations in ECG (prolongation of QTc interval). Consult doctor before taking FALCINIL LFX TABLET.

Others

FALCINIL LFX TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Severe type of malarial infection that has affected the brain
Low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in blood

Before taking FALCINIL LFX TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Infected with both the plasmodium falciparum and plasmodium vivax parasites
Feeling worse or if you feel too unwell to eat and drink

Use in pediatrics

FALCINIL LFX TABLET should be given with caution in children as the dosages of FALCINIL LFX TABLET vary in children according to their body weight. So, consult a paediatrician before you give this medicine to your child.

Use in geriatrics

FALCINIL LFX TABLET can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness or weakness after taking LUMET 80MG TABLET.

LUMET 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the kidneys. It should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking LUMET 80MG TABLET.
LUMET 80MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking LUMET 80MG TABLET.
Do not take LUMET 80MG TABLET if you are allergic to Artemether, Lumefantrine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
LUMET 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having malaria with pulmonary edema or severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LUMET 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease or with heart diseases such as slow heartbeat, changes in the rhythm or rate of the heartbeat or family history of death due to heart problems or born with heart problems. LUMET 80MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with variations in ECG (prolongation of QTc interval). Consult doctor before taking LUMET 80MG TABLET.

Others

LUMET 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Severe type of malarial infection that has affected the brain
Low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in blood

Before taking LUMET 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Infected with both the plasmodium falciparum and plasmodium vivax parasites
Feeling worse or if you feel too unwell to eat and drink

Use in pediatrics

LUMET 80MG TABLET should be given with caution in children as the dosages of LUMET 80MG TABLET vary in children according to their body weight. So, consult a paediatrician before you give this medicine to your child.

Use in geriatrics

LUMET 80MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

Medicines used to manage heart rhythm problems (Ex. Flecainide, metoprolol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. imipramine, amitriptyline, clomipramine, St. John’s wort)

Drink grapefruit juice with caution while taking LUMET 80MG TABLET as it may interact with this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION

FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION contains Artesunate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used for the management of severe malaria including cerebral malaria in adult and paediatric patients. Also, it can also be used against quinine resistance.   

Malaria is mosquito-borne acute febrile disease caused by a protozoan named Plasmodium falciparum. It is characterized by symptoms such as high fever, chills, sweating, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, body aches, weakness, agitation, confusion, fainting on standing up and anaemia (reduced red blood cell count). Cerebral malaria is the most severe neurological complication of Plasmodium falciparum malaria which may also cause coma.

FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have previous history of allergic reactions to artesunate or artemisinin derivatives. Before receiving FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you liver or kidney problems or any other problems.

FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION.  

FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION to your child. 

The most common side effects associated with the use of FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION are dizziness, light-headedness, headache, rash, hair loss, taste alteration (metallic/bitter taste), nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.
uses: Manage severe malaria including cerebral malaria

Manage severe malaria including cerebral malaria
mechanismOfAction:
How FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION Works

FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION helps in managing malaria where Artesunate works by transforming into a metabolite and binds with iron component of blood and forms free radicals which inhibit the synthesis of protein and nucleic acid in Plasmodium parasites and manages it from invading red blood cells, thus managing the malaria effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION

FALCINIL FORTE 120MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse intravenously (into the vein) or intramuscularly (into the muscle). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About HCQS 300MG TABLET

HCQS 300MG TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. HCQS 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking HCQS 300MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. HCQS 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. HCQS 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking HCQS 300MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How HCQS 300MG TABLET Works

HCQS 300MG TABLET works by increasing the potential of Hydrogen (pH) in a cell which disrupts the survival of infectious organisms and it also decreases the release of inflammatory enzymes. As a result, HCQS 300MG TABLET manages malarial infections in children and adults, it also manages rheumatoid arthritis and lupus erythematosus in adults.

How to use HCQS 300MG TABLET

Always take HCQS 300MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease conditions.

Others

Experience change in eye color or any other problem

Have abnormal blood sugar levels
Have glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency or porphyria
Have psoriasis
Have a blood disorder such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia
Have any problems with nervous system or brain
Have serious stomach or gut problems

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. KAIQUIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. KAIQUIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). How KAIQUIN 200MG TABLET Works

KAIQUIN 200MG TABLET works by increasing the potential of Hydrogen (pH) in a cell which disrupts the survival of infectious organisms and it also decreases the release of inflammatory enzymes. As a result, KAIQUIN 200MG TABLET manages malarial infections in children and adults, it also manages rheumatoid arthritis and lupus erythematosus in adults.

Have psoriasis
