Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking KAIQUIN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinedione such as pioglitazone, metformin (used to manage diabetes)
Digoxin, amiodarone (used to manage heart disease)
Azithromycin, clarithromycin, erythromycin, gentamicin, neomycin, tobramycin and  moxifloxacin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Neostigmine and pyridostigmine (used to manage myasthenia gravis and muscle weakness)
Tamoxifen (used to manage eye infections)
Halofantrine, mefloquine (used to manage malarial infection)
Amisulpride, quetiapine, risperidone (used to manage psychiatric disorders)
Rabies vaccine (used to manage rabies)
Ciclosporin (used to manage organ transplant rejection)
Praziquantel (used to manage worm infections)
Agalsidase (used to manage fabry’s disease)
Carbamazepine, sodium valproate, topiramate (used to manage fits or seizures)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes more of KAIQUIN 200MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital immediately if the symptoms worsen. The symptoms may include abnormal or low blood pressure, low potassium levels in the blood, abnormal heartbeat, depression, seizures, impaired vision, transient blindness, cardiac arrest, coma or death.

Insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinedione such as pioglitazone, metformin (used to manage diabetes)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes more of HCQS 400MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital immediately if the symptoms worsen. The symptoms may include abnormal or low blood pressure, low potassium levels in the blood, abnormal heartbeat, depression, seizures, impaired vision, transient blindness, cardiac arrest, coma or death.

faqs.question: Q: Can HCQS 400MG TABLET be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: HCQS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice before taking HCQS 400MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are planning or doubt if you are pregnant.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of HCQS 400MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking HCQS 400MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is HCQS 400MG TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: HCQS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. HCQS 400MG TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking HCQS 400MG TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking HCQS 400MG TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take HCQS 400MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of HCQS 400MG TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

introduction:
Introduction About LUMERAX 60MG TABLET

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET is a combination of Artemether and Lumefantrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used in infants, children and adults for the management of acute uncomplicated malaria (mosquito borne disease with symptoms of fever with chills, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain) caused by a parasite called plasmodium falciparum.  

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney problems or if the patient feels worse or unwell to eat and drink.

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs, kidney or brain, heart condition such as changes in the heart rhythm, slow heartbeat or severe heart disease and low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in the blood.

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during the second and third trimester of pregnancy and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor.  

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s age and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking LUMERAX 60MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, vomiting, stomach pain, nausea, muscle pain and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUMERAX 60MG TABLET
Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How LUMERAX 60MG TABLET Works

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET effectively manages malarial infections, where artemether effectively kills the malarial parasites by binding to haem (part of molecules that contains iron which is toxic to malarial parasites) which is produced during the breakdown of haemoglobin. Lumefantrine works by binding to hemin where it manages the formation of a toxic malarial pigment called hemozoin, thereby it manages malarial infection. In addition to this artemether and lumefantrine blocks nucleic acid and protein synthesis in parasite that damages the parasitic cell membrane of plasmodium falciparum which leads to the death of parasite. Thus, it helps in managing the malarial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use LUMERAX 60MG TABLET

Take LUMERAX 60MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow LUMERAX 60MG TABLET with a glass of water. This medicine should be taken with food or drinks rich in fat such as milk. Crush the medicine into powder if your child is unable to swallow the whole medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LUMERAX 60MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition.

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having malaria with pulmonary edema or severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease or with heart diseases such as slow heartbeat, changes in the rhythm or rate of the heartbeat or family history of death due to heart problems or born with heart problems. LUMERAX 60MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with variations in ECG (prolongation of QTc interval). Consult doctor before taking LUMERAX 60MG TABLET.

Others

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Severe type of malarial infection that has affected the brain
Low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in blood

Before taking LUMERAX 60MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Infected with both the plasmodium falciparum and plasmodium vivax parasites
Feeling worse or if you feel too unwell to eat and drink

Use in pediatrics

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET should be given with caution in children as the dosages of LUMERAX 60MG TABLET vary in children according to their body weight. So, consult a paediatrician before you give this medicine to your child.

Use in geriatrics

LUMERAX 60MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About DENG 200MG TABLET

DENG 200MG TABLET contains Hydroxychloroquine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials or Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (DMARDs). It is used to manage malarial infection. Malaria is a parasitic infection caused by the plasmodium parasite, which spreads in blood by the bite of an infectious mosquito. It is characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, sweating, headache, nausea, vomiting, body pain and general discomfort. It is also used to manage rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus in adults and manages juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children. Also, it is used to manage skin problems (which are sensitive to sunlight). It is used in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control of patients on metformin and sulfonylurea combination.

Rheumatoid arthritis, discoid and systemic lupus erythematosus is an inflammatory autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks its own body cells. It is generalized by symptoms such as painful swelling, stiffness, swelling, tenderness or weakness of bone joints, weakness, fever, skin rashes and anemia. DENG 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with maculopathy or retinal disorder of the eye and changes in eye color, etc. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking DENG 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have heart disease, psoriasis or porphyria, blood disorders (such as aplastic anemia, agranulocytosis, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia) glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, psychological disorders, abnormal blood sugar levels. DENG 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. DENG 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking DENG 200MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Can DENG 200MG TABLET be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: DENG 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice before taking DENG 200MG TABLET. Inform your doctor if you are planning or doubt if you are pregnant.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of DENG 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking DENG 200MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: Is DENG 200MG TABLET safe for use in patients with diabetes?
faqs.answer: A: DENG 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes. Inform your doctor if you have diabetes and taking medicines to manage the condition such as insulin, sulfonylureas such as glimepiride, meglitinide, thiazolidinediones such as pioglitazone, metformin, etc. DENG 200MG TABLET can lower the blood sugar levels. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or persist.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking DENG 200MG TABLET if my symptoms of the disease subside?
faqs.answer: A: Though the symptoms of your disease subside, do not stop taking DENG 200MG TABLET unless recommended by your doctor as the disease and its symptoms may worsen back again. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: What happens when you forget to take DENG 200MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: If you forget to take a dose of DENG 200MG TABLET on time, take it as soon as you remember. However, skip the missing dose if it’s time for the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed dose.

Your doctor might monitor your blood glucose levels routinely. The most common side effect of taking CINKONA 150MG SUSPENSION is cinchonism (headache, vasodilatation and sweating, nausea, ringing in ears, hearing impairment, spinning sensation, dizziness, blurred vision, and disturbance in color perception. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About COMBITHER TABLET

COMBITHER TABLET is a combination of Artemether and Lumefantrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used in infants, children and adults for the management of acute uncomplicated malaria (mosquito borne disease with symptoms of fever with chills, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain) caused by a parasite called plasmodium falciparum.  

COMBITHER TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney problems or if the patient feels worse or unwell to eat and drink.

COMBITHER TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs, kidney or brain, heart condition such as changes in the heart rhythm, slow heartbeat or severe heart disease and low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in the blood.

COMBITHER TABLET is generally not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during the second and third trimester of pregnancy and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor.  

COMBITHER TABLET should be used with caution in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s age and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking COMBITHER TABLET are headache, dizziness, vomiting, stomach pain, nausea, muscle pain and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of COMBITHER TABLET
Manage acute uncomplicated malarial infections (caused by plasmodium falciparum) in infants, children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How COMBITHER TABLET Works

COMBITHER TABLET effectively manages malarial infections, where artemether effectively kills the malarial parasites by binding to haem (part of molecules that contains iron which is toxic to malarial parasites) which is produced during the breakdown of haemoglobin. Lumefantrine works by binding to hemin where it manages the formation of a toxic malarial pigment called hemozoin, thereby it manages malarial infection. In addition to this artemether and lumefantrine blocks nucleic acid and protein synthesis in parasite that damages the parasitic cell membrane of plasmodium falciparum which leads to the death of parasite. Thus, it helps in managing the malarial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use COMBITHER TABLET

Take COMBITHER TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow COMBITHER TABLET with a glass of water. This medicine should be taken with food or drinks rich in fat such as milk. Crush the medicine into powder if your child is unable to swallow the whole medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse COMBITHER TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition.

COMBITHER TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease or with heart diseases such as slow heartbeat, changes in the rhythm or rate of the heartbeat or family history of death due to heart problems or born with heart problems. COMBITHER TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with variations in ECG (prolongation of QTc interval). Consult doctor before taking COMBITHER TABLET.

Severe type of malarial infection that has affected the brain
Low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in blood

Infected with both the plasmodium falciparum and plasmodium vivax parasites
Feeling worse or if you feel too unwell to eat and drink

COMBITHER TABLET should be given with caution in children as the dosages of COMBITHER TABLET vary in children according to their body weight. So, consult a paediatrician before you give this medicine to your child.

Use in geriatrics

COMBITHER TABLET can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION

RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION contains Artesunate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used for the management of severe malaria including cerebral malaria in adult and paediatric patients. Also, it can also be used against quinine resistance. 

Malaria is mosquito-borne acute febrile disease caused by a protozoan named Plasmodium falciparum. It is characterized by symptoms such as high fever, chills, sweating, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, body aches, weakness, agitation, confusion, fainting on standing up and anaemia (reduced red blood cell count). Cerebral malaria is the most severe neurological complication of Plasmodium falciparum malaria which may also cause coma.

RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have previous history of allergic reactions to artesunate or artemisinin derivatives. Before receiving RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION inform your doctor if you liver or kidney problems or any other problems.

RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION is not recommended for use during first trimester of pregnancy. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION.  

RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION should be used with caution in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION to your child. 

The most common side effects associated with the use of RTSUNATE 60 INJECTION are dizziness, light-headedness, headache, rash, hair loss, taste alteration (metallic/bitter taste), nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET is a combination of Artemether and Lumefantrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimalarials. It is used in infants, children and adults for the management of acute uncomplicated malaria (mosquito borne disease with symptoms of fever with chills, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain) caused by a parasite called plasmodium falciparum.  

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney problems or if the patient feels worse or unwell to eat and drink.

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs, kidney or brain, heart condition such as changes in the heart rhythm, slow heartbeat or severe heart disease and low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in the blood.

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during the second and third trimester of pregnancy and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor.  

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s age and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, vomiting, stomach pain, nausea, muscle pain and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET Works

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET effectively manages malarial infections, where artemether effectively kills the malarial parasites by binding to haem (part of molecules that contains iron which is toxic to malarial parasites) which is produced during the breakdown of haemoglobin. Lumefantrine works by binding to hemin where it manages the formation of a toxic malarial pigment called hemozoin, thereby it manages malarial infection. In addition to this artemether and lumefantrine blocks nucleic acid and protein synthesis in parasite that damages the parasitic cell membrane of plasmodium falciparum which leads to the death of parasite. Thus, it helps in managing the malarial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET

Take FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET with a glass of water. This medicine should be taken with food or drinks rich in fat such as milk. Crush the medicine into powder if your child is unable to swallow the whole medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the disease condition.

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET should be taken with caution in breast feeding women only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness or weakness after taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET.

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe type of malarial infection affecting the kidneys. It should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET.
FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET.
Do not take FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET if you are allergic to Artemether, Lumefantrine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having malaria with pulmonary edema or severe type of malarial infection affecting the lungs. Consult your doctor before taking it.

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease or with heart diseases such as slow heartbeat, changes in the rhythm or rate of the heartbeat or family history of death due to heart problems or born with heart problems. FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with variations in ECG (prolongation of QTc interval). Consult doctor before taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET.

Others

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Severe type of malarial infection that has affected the brain
Low levels of electrolytes such as potassium or magnesium in blood

Before taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Infected with both the plasmodium falciparum and plasmodium vivax parasites
Feeling worse or if you feel too unwell to eat and drink

Use in pediatrics

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET should be given with caution in children as the dosages of FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET vary in children according to their body weight. So, consult a paediatrician before you give this medicine to your child.

Use in geriatrics

FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug – drug interactions:

Before taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage heart rhythm problems (Ex. Flecainide, metoprolol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. imipramine, amitriptyline, clomipramine, St. John’s wort)
Medicine used to manage leprosy or tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (EX.  fluroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin, macrolide antibiotics like azithromycin, erythromycin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infection (Ex. ketoconazole, fluconazole, itraconazole)
Medicines used to manage allergy (Ex. terfenadine, astemizole)
Medicine used to manage stomach disturbance (Ex. cisapride)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex.  atovaquone/proguanil, chloroquine)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. Ethinyl estradiol)

B. Drug – Food interactions

Drink grapefruit juice with caution while taking FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET as it may interact with this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of FELBAN AL 40/240MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital.
